automatic_rule: Per clip compute metrics, linearly clamp quality from good/bad anchors; equal clip weighting. Hard gates separately apply to each clip.

hard_constraints.inputs: 2 clips,100 distinct consecutive source frames each,512x288; benchmark25fps. PNG authoritative; MP4 for browsing only.
hard_constraints.archives: ZIP_STORED or DEFLATED, exactly0000.png..0099.png at ZIP root, no links/extra paths; RGBA8 straight alpha sRGB; each decompressed PNG<=2MB.
hard_constraints.preview: dark_1/light_1/dark_2/light_2 MP4,100frames,512x288,25fps,no audio; linear-light recomposition using corresponding supplied background; per-frame RGB MAE<=0.035
hard_constraints.identity: clip1 only long-haired woman with glasses; clip2 adult+child both. Blue-shirt bearded man is excluded even when he occludes target. Strip excluded; no completion behind occluders.
hard_constraints.interior: truth alpha>=0.95: candidate alpha<0.5 on>10% interior for>=7 consecutive frames fails. Mean interior alpha error<=0.10.
hard_constraints.soft_edges: mean absolute alpha error on0.02<truth<0.98<=0.12; Sobel edge error reported separately
hard_constraints.occlusion: event-region mean alpha error<=0.12; no ignored frames or duplicated static masks
hard_constraints.color: four-background linear compositing error on truth alpha>0.02<=0.15; invisible RGB is not graded
hard_constraints.frame_map: exact identity mapping0..99 in each clip; no skipped frames
hard_constraints.temporal: fixed truth backward flow; compare candidate-vs-truth warp residual only in visible correspondence mask, mean<=0.09
hard_constraints.straight_foreground_color: mean sRGB foreground error in truth0.05<alpha<0.95<=0.15; RGB below alpha0.05 not graded

metric_definitions.soft_edges: 0.7*quality(soft_mae)+0.3*quality(gradient_mae), Sobel divided by4, mean x/y absolute error on3px truth contour band
metric_definitions.occlusion: region where target amodal alpha>0.03 and foreground excluded alpha>0.03; also visible target in outer12px canvas band
metric_definitions.temporal: |(pred_t-warp(pred_prev))-(truth_t-warp(truth_prev))|, fixed Farneback flow with trusted photometric and visibility mask
metric_definitions.color: 50% four-background linear compositing quality and50% unassociated sRGB foreground quality in soft truth pixels; composite anchor0.02/0.15, foreground0.04/0.20
metric_definitions.foreground: original foreground color transformed with premultiplied resampling then unassociated; mathematical layer truth

judge_items.criterion: 原输入、候选与真值对照：两镜头目标身份正确，clip2成人与孩子均保留；蓝衣男子和竖条完全排除，遮挡后及时显露，不补全被挡身体。

rating_anchors.0: 换身份、混入干扰人/遮挡物或大段丢失目标。
rating_anchors.0.5: 主要身份与显隐正确，局部显露有短暂瑕疵。
rating_anchors.1: 身份、两人间隙、遮挡/重新显露均正确且连续。

judge_items.criterion: 实际深浅背景及棋盘重合成中，长发、眼镜、手指、衣服与两人间隙自然；无明显黑边、原背景染色、硬切边或整圈侵蚀。

rating_anchors.0: 主要轮廓不可用或明显大范围色边/硬边。
rating_anchors.0.5: 可用于合成但局部发丝/手部或颜色边缘需修补。
rating_anchors.1: 所有主要边缘在多背景下自然，细节和软透明保留。

judge_items.criterion: 逐帧/连续观看，无不随原运动的遮罩跳变、呼吸、冻结、粘背景；出画/遮挡不是凭空淡出。

rating_anchors.0: 持续闪烁/冻结或明显错帧。
rating_anchors.0.5: 总体连续，少量局部不稳定。
rating_anchors.1: 与真实运动和遮挡同步，未见影响复用的时序错误。

unverified: missing judge or environment =>formal_total=null; hard failure =>accepted=false
